thread:
Nate: quick PR for Security -> Audit wording. Legal called out 'we are SOC2 compliant' as too definitive. Proposed sentence: 'Redwood maintains controls in accordance with SOC 2 trust service criteria and undergoes independent third-party audit.' PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2120

Celine: that phrasing looks safer. can we also include a tiny migration hint for customers upgrading from v1 -> v2 audit schema and a short Ruby + Go SDK snippet? engineers asked for both.

Nate: added minimal migration before/after and two SDK examples in the PR comment. pasting them here so legal/lint can see. BEFORE (v1):
```json
{
  "evt": "e_01",
  "user_id": "u_123",
  "email": "pat@org.com",
  "action": "auth.login",
  "time": "2026-12-01T12:00:00Z"
}
```
AFTER (v2 export with redaction):
```json
{
  "id": "e_01",
  "actor": { "id": "anon_9f", "email": "REDACTED" },
  "type": "auth.login",
  "timestamp": "2026-12-01T12:00:00Z",
  "redacted": true
}
```
Ruby SDK sketch (pseudo):
```ruby
client = Redwood::Audit.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
client.log({ type: 'auth.login', actor: { id: 'usr_x' } }, retention: '60d', redact: ['actor.email'])
```
Go SDK sketch (pseudo):
```go
cli := redwood.NewAuditClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
cli.LogEvent(context.Background(), Event{Type: "auth.login", Actor: Actor{ID: "usr_x"}}, WithRetention("60d"), Redact("actor.email"))
```

Ron: nice and compact. legal: prefer 'SOC 2' with a space. also add a short customer action line for attestation/export requests. maybe point to compliance@redwood.com?

Sara: ACK with minor edits: change 'in accordance with' -> 'in alignment with' for tone (so the sentence reads: 'Redwood maintains controls in alignment with SOC 2 trust service criteria and undergoes independent third-party audit.') add: 'For attestation copies or export procedures, contact compliance@redwood.com.'

Nate: updated PR accordingly, removed any inline comments from JSON, and labeled code fences (json, ruby, go). also added a one-line defaults note: hosted default audit retention: 90 days; Dedicated/Private: configurable per-tenant/contract.

docs-ci-bot: PR check  lint error: code-block language tags must be one of json, bash, python, ruby, go. Found invalid or missing tags in one fence. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/2120/logs

Nate: fixing the fence labels and pushing. will merge once CI passes and legal confirms final wording. thanks all :white_check_mark:
